spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_ETHERTYPE_PPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx ethertype ppp. Ethertype for transmitting priority pause packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_OPCODE_PPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx opcode ppp. Opcode for transmitting priority pause packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_ETHERTYPE_GPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx ethertype gpp. Ethertype for transmitting priority pause packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_OPCODE_GPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx opcode gpp. Opcode for transmitting priority pause packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_DA_GPP_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx da gpp. Destination address for transmitting global pause packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_DA_GPP_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx da gpp. Destination address for transmitting global pause packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_SA_GPP_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx sa gpp. Source address for transmitting global pause packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_SA_GPP_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx sa gpp. Source address for transmitting global pause packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_DA_PPP_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx da ppp. Destination address for transmitting priority pause packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_DA_PPP_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx da ppp. Destination address for transmitting priority pause packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_SA_PPP_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx sa ppp. Source address for transmitting priority pause packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_SA_PPP_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx sa ppp. Source address for transmitting priority pause packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_PAUSE_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: Rx pause enable. This input is used to enable the processing of the pause quanta for the corresponding priority.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_FORWARD_CONTROL
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx forward control. 0 - causes core to drop control packets. 1 - Indicates that the core forwards control packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_ENABLE_GCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx enable gcp. 1 - Enables global control packet processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_ENABLE_PCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx enable pcp. 1 - Enables priority control packet processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_ENABLE_GPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx enable gpp. 1 - Enables global pause packet processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_ENABLE_PPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx enable ppp. 1 - Enables priority pause packet processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_ACK
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check ack. 0 - ctl_rx_pause_ack[8:0] is not used. 1 - the core uses the ctl_rx_pause_ack[8:0] bus for pause processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_MCAST_GCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check mcast gcp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables global control multicast destination address processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_UCAST_GCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check ucast gcp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables global control unicast destination address processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_SA_GCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check sa gcp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables global control source address processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_ETYPE_GCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check etype gcp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables global control ethertype processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_OPCODE_GCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check opcode gcp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables global control opcodeprocessing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_MCAST_PCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check mcast pcp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables priority control multicast destination address processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_UCAST_PCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check ucast pcp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables priority control unicast destination address processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_SA_PCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check sa pcp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables priority control source address processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_ETYPE_PCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check etype pcp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables priority control ethertype processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_OPCODE_PCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check opcode pcp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables priority control opcode processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_MCAST_GPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check mcast gpp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables global pause multicast destination address processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_UCAST_GPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check ucast gpp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables global pause unicast destination address processing

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_SA_GPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check sa gpp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables global pause source address processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_ETYPE_GPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check etype gpp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables global pause ethertype processing

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_OPCODE_GPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check opcode gpp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables global pause opcode processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_MCAST_PPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check mcast ppp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables priority pause multicast destination address processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_UCAST_PPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check ucast ppp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables priority pause unicast destination address processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_SA_PPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check sa ppp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables priority pause source address processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_ETYPE_PPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check etype ppp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables priority pause ethertype processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_OPCODE_PPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check opcode ppp. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables priority pause opcode processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_ETYPE_PPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx etype ppp. Ethertype field for priority pause processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_OPCODE_PPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx opcode ppp. Priority pause opcode value.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_ETYPE_GPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx etype gpp. Ethertype field for global pause processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_OPCODE_GPP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx opcode gpp. Global pause opcode value.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_ETYPE_GCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx etype gcp. Ethertype field for global control processing

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_ETYPE_PCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx etype pcp. Ethertype field for priority control processing

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_OPCODE_MIN_PCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx opcode min pcp. Minimum priority control opcode value.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_OPCODE_MAX_PCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx opcode max pcp. Maximum priority control opcode value.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_OPCODE_MIN_GCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx opcode min gcp. Minimum global control opcode value.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_OPCODE_MAX_GCP
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx opcode max gcp. Maximum global control opcode value.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_PAUSE_DA_UCAST_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx pause da ucast. Unicast destination address for pause processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_PAUSE_DA_UCAST_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx pause da ucast. Unicast destination address for pause processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_PAUSE_DA_MCAST_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx pause da mcast. Multicast destination address for pause processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_PAUSE_DA_MCAST_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx pause da mcast. Multicast destination address for pause processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_PAUSE_SA_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx pause sa. Source address for pause processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_PAUSE_SA_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx pause sa. Source address for pause processing.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RSFEC_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rsfec enable. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enable RS-FEC function.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RSFEC_CONSORTIUM_25G
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rsfec consortium 25g. This signal switches between IEEE Clause 108 and 25G Ethernet Consortium modes. 0 - IEEE 802.3by mode. 1 - 25G Consortium specification mode.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_RSFEC_ENABLE_INDICATION
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx rsfec enable indication. 0 - Bypass the error indication function (see IEEE Std 802.3by section 91.5.3.3). 1 - Decoder indicates errors to the PCS sublayer

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_RSFEC_ENABLE_CORRECTION
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx rsfec enable correction. 0 - Decoder performs error detection without error correction (see IEEE 802.3by Clause 91.5.3.3). 1 - Decoder also performs error correction.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RSFEC_IEEE_ERROR_INDICATION_MODE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rsfec ieee error indication mode. 0 - If ctl_rx_rsfec_enable_correction and ctl_rx_rsfec_enable_indication are set to zero, the RS decoder is bypassed. 1 - Core conforms to the IEEE RS-FEC specification.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_FEC_RX_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl fec rx enable. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enable the clause 74 FEC decoding of the received data.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_FEC_TX_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl fec tx enable. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enable the clause 74 FEC encoding on the transmitted data.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_FEC_ENABLE_ERROR_TO_PCS
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl fec enable error to pcs. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Clause 74 FEC enable error to PCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AUTONEG_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl autoneg enable. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enable signal for auto-negotiation.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AUTONEG_BYPASS
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl autoneg bypass. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Auto-negotiation is turned off, but the PCS is connected to the output to allow operation.

spirit:field.spirit:name: _CTL_AN_NONCE_SEED
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an nonce seed. 8-bit seed to initialize the nonce field Polynomial generator.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_PSEUDO_SEL
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an pseudo sel. Selects the polynomial generator for the bit 49 random bit generator. 0 - The polynomial is x7+x3+1. 1 - The polynomial is x7+x6+1.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RESTART_NEGOTIATION
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl restart negotiation. This input is used to trigger a restart of the auto-negotiation, regardless of what state the circuit is currently in.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_LOCAL_FAULT
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an local fault. This input signal is used to set the local_fault bit of the transmit link codeword.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_PAUSE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an pause. This is used to set the PAUSE bit, (C0), of the transmit link codeword. This signal might not be present if the core does not support pause.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ASMDIR
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an asmdir. This is used to set the ASMDIR bit, (C1), of the transmit link codeword. This signal might not be present if the core does not support pause.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_FEC_10G_REQUEST
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an fec 10g request. This signal is used to signal the link partner that the local station is requesting clause 74 FEC on the 10Gb/s lane protocols.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_FEC_ABILITY_OVERRIDE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an fec ability override. 1 - Then the FEC ability bit in the transmit link codeword is cleared.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_CL91_FEC_REQUEST
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an cl91 fec request. This bit is used to request clause 91 FEC.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_CL91_FEC_ABILITY
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an cl91 fec ability. This bit is used to indicate clause 91 FEC ability.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_FEC_25G_RS_REQUEST
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an fec 25g rs request. This signal is used to signal the link partner that the local station is requesting rs FEC (clause 91 or 108) on the 25Gb/s lane protocols.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_FEC_25G_BASER_REQUEST
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an fec 25g baser request. Indicates the baser FEC request.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_1000BASE_KX
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 1000base kx. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_10GBASE_KX4
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 10gbase kx4. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_10GBASE_KR
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 10gbase kr. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_40GBASE_KR4
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 40gbase kr4. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_40GBASE_CR4
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 40gbase cr4. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_100GBASE_CR10
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl_an_ability_100gbase_cr10. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_100GBASE_KP4
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 100gbase kp4. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_100GBASE_KR4
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 100gbase kr4. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_100GBASE_CR4
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 100gbase cr4. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_25GBASE_KRCR_S
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 25gbase krcr s. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_25GBASE_KRCR
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 25gbase krcr. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_25GBASE_KR1
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 25gbase kr1. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_25GBASE_CR1
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 25gbase cr1. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_50GBASE_KR2
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 50gbase kr2. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ABILITY_50GBASE_CR2
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an ability 50gbase cr2. 0 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it doesn't supports the protocol. 1 - Indicates that the interface advertises that it supports the protocol.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LT_TRAINING_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl lt training enable. 0 - When link training is disabled, all PCS lanes function in mission mode. 1 - Enabled link training

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LT_RESTART_TRAINING
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl lt restart training. 0 - Normal operation 1 - This signal triggers a restart of link training regardless of the current state.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LT_RX_TRAINED
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl lt rx trained. 1 - Indicates that the receiver finite impulse response (FIR) filter coefficients have all been set, and that the receiver portion of training is complete.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LT_PRESET_TO_TX
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl lt preset to tx. 0 - Normal operation. Doesn't set any value the preset bit. 1 - set the value of the preset bit that is transmitted to the link partner in the control block of the training frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LT_INITIALIZE_TO_TX
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl lt initialize to tx. To set the value of the initialize bit that is transmitted to the link partner in the control block of the training frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LT_PSEUDO_SEED0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl lt pseudo seed0. This 11-bit signal seeds the training pattern generator.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LT_K_P1_TO_TX0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl lt k p1 to tx0. This 2-bit field is used to set the value of the k+1 coefficient update field that is transmitted to the link partner in the control block of the training frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LT_K0_TO_TX0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl ltk0 to tx0. This 2-bit field is used to set the value of the k0 coefficient update field that is transmitted to the link partner in the control block of the training frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LT_K_M1_TO_TX0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl lt k m1 to tx0. This 2-bit field is used to set the value of the k-1 coefficient update field that is transmitted to the link partner in the control block of the training frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LT_STAT_P1_TO_TX0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl lt stat p1 to tx0. This 2-bit field is used to set the value of the k+1 coefficient update status that is transmitted to the link partner in the status block of the training frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LT_STAT0_TO_TX0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl lt stat0 to tx0. This 2-bit field is used to set the value of the k0 coefficient update status that is transmitted to the link partner in the status block of the training frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LT_STAT_M1_TO_TX0
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl_lt_stat_m1_to_tx0. This 2-bit field is used to set the value of the k-1 coefficient update status that is transmitted to the link partner in the status block of the training frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: USER_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: user register0. User-defined signal from the AXI4-Reg map user_reg0 register.

spirit:field.spirit:name: AXI_CTL_CORE_MODE_SWITCH
spirit:field.spirit:description: axi ctl core mode switch. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables the mode switch line rate from 10G and 25G and vice versa.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_LATENCY
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx latency This is the static latency of the TX path of the core including the GT. The MSB 16 bits indicate the delay in ns and the LSB 16 bits indicate sub ns values.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_LATENCY
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx latency This is the static latency of the RX path of the core including the GT. The MSB 16 bits indicate the delay in ns and the LSB 16 bits indicate sub ns values.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_LOCAL_FAULT
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx local fault. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Indicates the receive decoder state machine is in the TX_INIT state. This output is level sensitive.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_GMII_FIFO_OVF_1H_R_OUT
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx gmii fifo ovf 1h r out. TX FIFO overflow.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_GMII_FIFO_UNF_1H_R_OUT
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx gmii fifo unf 1h r out. TX FIFO underflow.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_BAD_PARITY
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx bad parity. Increment on any clock cycle where the user-generated parity is calculated as incorrect by the Tx parity checking logic.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_HI_BER
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx hi ber. High Bit Error Rate Indicator. 1 - the BER is too high as defined by IEEE Std. 802.3. Corresponds to MDIO register bit 3.32.1 as defined in Clause 49.2.14.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_REMOTE_FAULT
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx remote fault. 0 - Remote fault condition does not exist. 1 - It indicates a remote fault condition was detected.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_LOCAL_FAULT
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx local fault. 1 - indicates the receive decoder state machine is in the RX_INIT state.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_INTERNAL_LOCAL_FAULT
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx internal local fault. 1 - when an internal local fault is generated due to test pattern generation or high bit error rate.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_RECEIVED_LOCAL_FAULT
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx received local fault. 0 - Normal operation 1 - when enough local fault words are received from the link partner to trigger a fault condition as specified by the IEEE fault state machine. Remains High as long as the fault condition persists.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_BAD_PREAMBLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx bad preamble. 0 - Indicates that an invalid preamble was not received. 1 - Indicates that an invalid preamble was received.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_BAD_SFD
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx bad sfd. Increment bad SFD. 0 - Indicates that an invalid SFD was not received. 1 - Indicates that an invalid SFD was received.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_GOT_SIGNAL_OS
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx got signal os. Signal OS indication. 1 - It indicates that a signal OS word was received.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_FIFO_ERROR
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx fifo error. Transmit clock compensation FIFO error indicator. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Indicates the clock compensation FIFO under or overflowed.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_PTP_FIFO_READ_ERROR
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx ptp fifo read error. Transmit PTP FIFO read error. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Indicates that an error occurred during the PTP Tag read.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_PTP_FIFO_WRITE_ERROR
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx ptp fifo write error. Transmit PTP FIFO write error. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Indicates that an error occurred during the PTP Tag write.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_FIFO_ERROR
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx fifo error. Receive clock compensation FIFO error indicator. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Indicates the clock compensation FIFO under or overflowed.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_BLOCK_LOCK
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx block lock Block lock status. 1 - Indicates that block lock is achieved as defined in Clause 49.2.14 and MDIO register 3.32.0

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_RSFEC_LANE_ALIGNMENT_STATUS
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx rsfec lane alignment status. 1 - Indicates that the RX RS-FEC block has achieved alignment on the data from the transceiver.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_RSFEC_HI_SER
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx rsfec hi ser. Indicates high symbol error. 1 - If the number of RS-FEC symbol errors in a window of 8192 codewords exceeds the threshold of 417.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_FEC_RX_LOCK
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat fec rx lock. 1 - while the ctl_fec_rx_enable is asserted when the FEC decoder detects the frame boundary.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_FEC_LOCK_ERROR
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat fec lock error. 1 - If the FEC decoder has been unable to detect the frame boundary after about 5 ms. It is cleared when the frame boundary is detected.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_RSFEC_LANE_ALIGNMENT_STATUS
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx rsfec lane alignment status. 1 - Indicates that the TX RS-FEC block has achieved alignment on the incoming PCS data.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_MM_VERIFY
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx mm verify. Indicates verification status. 0 - Indicates that verification is complete. 1 - Indicates that verification is successful.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_PAUSE_VALID
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx pause valid. If a bit of this bus is set to 1, the core has transmitted a pause packet. If bit[8] is set to 1, a global pause packet is transmitted.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PAUSE_REQ
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx pause req. Pause request signal. When the RX receives a valid pause frame, it sets the corresponding bit of this bus to a 1 and keep it at 1 until the pause packet has been processed.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PAUSE_VALID
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx pause valid. This bus indicates that a pause packet was received and the associated quanta on the stat_rx_pause_quanta[8:0][15:0] bus is valid and must be used for pause processing. If an 802.3x Ethernet MAC Pause packet is received, bit[8] is set to 1.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_FEC_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an fec enable. Used to enable the use of clause 74 FEC on the link.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_RS_FEC_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an rs fec enable. Used to enable the use of clause 91 FEC on the link.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_AUTONEG_COMPLETE
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an autoneg complete. 1 - Indicates the auto-negotiation is complete and rx link status from the PCS has been received.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_PARALLEL_DETECTION_FAULT
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an parallel detection fault. 1 - Indicated a parallel detection fault during auto-negotiation.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_TX_PAUSE_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an tx pause enable. 1 - Enable station-to-station (global) pause packet generation in the transmit path to control data flow in the receive path.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_RX_PAUSE_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an rx pause enable. 1 - Enable station-to-station (global) pause packet interpretation in the receive path, in order to control data flow from the transmitter.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_LP_ABILITY_VALID
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an lp ability valid. 1 - Indicates when all of the link partner advertisements become valid.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_LP_AUTONEG_ABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an lp autoneg able. 1 - Indicates that the link partner is able to perform auto-negotiation. It becomes valid when the output signal stat_AN_lp_Ability_Valid is asserted.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_LP_PAUSE
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an lp pause. 1 - Indicates the advertised value of the PAUSE bit, (C0), in the receive link codeword from the link partner. It becomes valid when the output signal stat_AN_lp_Ability_Valid is asserted.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_LP_ASM_DIR
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an lp asm dir. 1 - Indicates the advertised value of the ASMDIR bit, (C1), in the receive link codeword from the link partner. It becomes valid when the output signal stat_AN_lp_Ability_Valid is asserted.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_LP_RF
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an lp rf. 1 - Indicates link partner remote fault.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_LP_FEC_10G_ABILITY
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an lp fec 10g ability. 1 - Indicates the clause 74 FEC ability associated with 10Gb/s lane protocols that is being advertised by the link partner. It becomes valid when the output signal stat_an_lp_ability_valid is asserted.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_LP_FEC_10G_REQUEST
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an lp fec 10g request. 1 - Indicates that the link partner is requesting that the clause 74 FEC be used on the 10Gb/s lane protocols. It becomes valid when the output signal stat_an_lp_ability_valid is asserted.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_LP_EXTENDED_ABILITY_VALID
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an lp extended ability valid. 1 - It indicates that the detected extended abilities are valid.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_LP_ABILITY_EXTENDED_FEC
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an lp ability extended fec. Indicates the extended FEC abilities as defined in Schedule 3.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_LP_FEC_25G_RS_REQUEST
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat an lp fec 25g rs request. 1 - Indicates that the link partner is requesting the clause 91 (or 108) rs FEC be used for the 25gb/s lane protocols. It becomes valid when the output signal stat_an_lp_ability_valid is asserted.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_AN_LP_FEC_25G_BASER_REQUEST

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_INITIALIZE_FROM_RX
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt initialize from rx. This signal reflects the value of the initialize control bit received in the control block from the link partner.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_PRESET_FROM_RX
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt preset from rx. This signal reflects the value of the preset control bit received in the control block from the link partner.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_TRAINING
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt training. 1 - Indicates when the respective link training state machine is performing link training.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_FRAME_LOCK
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt frame lock. 1 - Asserted when link training has begun.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_SIGNAL_DETECT
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt signal detect. 1 - Indicates when the respective link training state machine has entered the SEND_DATA state, in which normal PCS operation can resume.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_TRAINING_FAIL
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt training fail. 1 - Asserted during link training if the corresponding link training state machine detects a time-out during the training period.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_RX_SOF
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt rx sof. 1 - For 1 RX SerDes clock cycle to indicate the start of the link training frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_K_P1_FROM_RX0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt k p1 from rx0. This 2-bit field indicates the update control bits for the k+1 coefficient, as received from the link partner in the control block.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_K0_FROM_RX0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt k0 from rx0. This 2-bit field indicates the update control bits for the k0 coefficient, as received from the link partner in the control block.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_K_M1_FROM_RX0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt k m1 from rx0. This 2-bit field indicates the update control bits for the k-1 coefficient, as received from the link partner in the control block.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_STAT_P1_FROM_RX0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt stat p1 from rx0. This 2-bit field indicates the update status bits for the k+1 coefficient, as received from the link partner in the status block.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_STAT0_FROM_RX0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt stat0 from rx0. This 2-bit field indicates the update status bits for the k0 coefficient, as received from the link partner in the status block.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_LT_STAT_M1_FROM_RX0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat lt stat m1 from rx0. This 2-bit field indicates the update status bits for the k-1 coefficient, as received from the link partner in the status block.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_VALID_CTRL_CODE
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx valid ctrl code. 1 - Indicates that a PCS block with a valid control code was received.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_CORE_SPEED
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat core speed. 0 - Standalone 25G 1 - Standalone 10G

spirit:field.spirit:name: RUNTIME_SWITCHABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: runtime switchable. 0 - Runtime Switchable 25G 1 - Runtime Switchable 10G

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_CYCLE_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat cycle reg0. Contains a count of the number of RX core clock cycles between TICK_REG writes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_CYCLE_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat cycle reg1. Contains a count of the number of RX core clock cycles between TICK_REG writes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_FRAMING_ERR_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx framing err reg0. RX sync header bits framing error. Each PCS Lane has a four-bit bus that indicates how many sync header errors were received for that PCS Lane. The value of the bus is only valid when the corresponding stat_rx_framing_err_valid is a 1. The values on these buses can be updated at any time and are intended to be used as increment values for sync header error counters.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_FRAMING_ERR_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx framing err reg1. RX sync header bits framing error. Each PCS Lane has a four-bit bus that indicates how many sync header errors were received for that PCS Lane. The value of the bus is only valid when the corresponding stat_rx_framing_err_valid is a 1. The values on these buses can be updated at any time and are intended to be used as increment values for sync header error counters.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_BAD_CODE_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx bad code reg0. Increment for 64B/66B code violations. This signal indicates that the RX PCS receive state machine is in the RX_E state as specified by the IEEE Std 802.3-2015.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_BAD_CODE_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx bad code reg1. Increment for 64B/66B code violations. This signal indicates that the RX PCS receive state machine is in the RX_E state as specified by the IEEE Std 802.3-2015.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_ERROR_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx error reg0. Test pattern mismatch increment. A non-zero value in any cycle indicates a mismatch occurred for the test pattern in the RX core. This output is only active when ctl_rx_test_pattern is set.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_ERROR_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx error reg1. Test pattern mismatch increment. A non-zero value in any cycle indicates a mismatch occurred for the test pattern in the RX core. This output is only active when ctl_rx_test_pattern is set.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_RSFEC_CORRECTED_CW_INC_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx rsfec corrected cw inc reg0. Increment for corrected errors.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_RSFEC_CORRECTED_CW_INC_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx rsfec corrected cw inc reg1. Increment for corrected errors.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_RSFEC_UNCORRECTED_CW_INC_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx rsfec uncorrected cw inc reg0. Increment for uncorrected errors.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_RSFEC_UNCORRECTED_CW_INC_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx rsfec uncorrected cw inc reg1. Increment for uncorrected errors.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_RSFEC_ERR_COUNT0_INC_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx rsfec err count inc reg0. Increment for detected errors.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_RSFEC_ERR_COUNT0_INC_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx rsfec err count inc reg1. Increment for detected errors.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_FRAME_ERROR_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx frame error reg0. Increment for packets with tx_axis_tuser set to indicate an End of Packet(EOP) abort.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_FRAME_ERROR_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx frame error reg1. Increment for packets with tx_axis_tuser set to indicate an End of Packet(EOP) abort.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_TOTAL_PACKETS_REG0

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_TOTAL_PACKETS_REG1

spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx total good packets reg0. Increment for the total number of good bytes received. This value is only non-zero when a packet is received completely and contains no errors.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_TOTAL_GOOD_PACKETS_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx total good packets reg1. Increment for the total number of good bytes received. This value is only non-zero when a packet is received completely and contains no errors.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_TOTAL_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx total bytes reg0. Increment for the total number of bytes received.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_TOTAL_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx total bytes reg1. Increment for the total number of bytes received.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_TOTAL_GOOD_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx total good bytes reg0. Increment for the total number of good bytes received. This value is only non-zero when a packet is received completely and contains no errors.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_TOTAL_GOOD_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx total good bytes reg1. Increment for the total number of good bytes received. This value is only non-zero when a packet is received completely and contains no errors.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_64_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 64 bytes reg0. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 64 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_64_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 64 bytes reg1. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 64 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_65_127_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 65-127 bytes reg0. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 65 to 127 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_65_127_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 65-127 bytes reg1. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 65 to 127 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_128_255_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 128-255 bytes reg0. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 128 to 255 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_128_255_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 128-255 bytes reg1. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 128 to 255 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_256_511_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 256-511 bytes reg0. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 256 to 511 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_256_511_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 256-511 bytes reg1. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 256 to 511 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_512_1023_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 512-1023 bytes reg0. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 512 to 1,023 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_512_1023_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 512-1023 bytes reg1. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 512 to 1,023 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_1024_1518_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 1024-1518 bytes reg0. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 1,024 to 1,518 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_1024_1518_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 1024-1518 bytes reg1. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 1,024 to 1,518 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_1519_1522_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 1519-1522 bytes reg0. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 1519 to 1522 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_1519_1522_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 1519-1522 bytes reg1. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 1519 to 1522 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_1523_1548_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 1523-1548 bytes reg0. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 1,523 to 1,548 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_1523_1548_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 1523-1548 bytes reg1. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 1,523 to 1,548 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_1549_2047_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 1549-2047 bytes reg0. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 1,549 to 2,047 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_1549_2047_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 1549-2047 bytes reg1. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 1,549 to 2,047 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_2048_4095_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 2048-4095 bytes reg0. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 2,048 to 4,095 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_2048_4095_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 2048-4095 bytes reg1. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 2,048 to 4,095 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_4096_8191_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 4096-8191 bytes reg0. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 4,096 to 8,191 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_4096_8191_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 4096-8191 bytes reg1. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 4,096 to 8,191 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_8192_9215_BYTES_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 8192-9215 bytes reg0. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 8,192 to 9,215 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_8192_9215_BYTES_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet 8192-9215 bytes reg1. Increment for good and bad packets received that contain 8,192 to 9,215 bytes.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_LARGE_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet large reg0. Increment for all packets that are more than 9,215 bytes long.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_LARGE_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet large reg1. Increment for all packets that are more than 9,215 bytes long.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_SMALL_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet small reg0. Increment for all packets that are less than 64 bytes long. Packets that are less than four bytes are dropped.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_SMALL_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet small reg1. Increment for all packets that are less than 64 bytes long. Packets that are less than four bytes are dropped.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_UNDERSIZE_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx undersize reg0. Increment for packets shorter than ctl_rx_min_packet_len with good FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_UNDERSIZE_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx undersize reg1. Increment for packets shorter than ctl_rx_min_packet_len with good FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_FRAGMENT_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx fragment reg0. Increment for packets shorter than ctl_rx_min_packet_len with bad FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_FRAGMENT_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx fragment reg1. Increment for packets shorter than ctl_rx_min_packet_len with bad FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_OVERSIZE_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx oversize reg0. Increment for packets longer than ctl_rx_max_packet_len with good FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_OVERSIZE_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx oversize reg1. Increment for packets longer than ctl_rx_max_packet_len with good FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_TOOLONG_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx toolong reg0. Increment for packets longer than ctl_rx_max_packet_len with good and bad FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_TOOLONG_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx toolong reg1. Increment for packets longer than ctl_rx_max_packet_len with good and bad FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_JABBER_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx jabber reg0. Increment for packets longer than ctl_rx_max_packet_len with bad FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_JABBER_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx jabber reg1. Increment for packets longer than ctl_rx_max_packet_len with bad FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_BAD_FCS_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx bad fcs reg0. Bad FCS indicator. The value on this bus indicates packets received with a bad FCS, but not a stomped FCS during a cycle. This output is pulsed for one clock cycle to indicate an error condition.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_BAD_FCS_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx bad fcs reg1. Bad FCS indicator. The value on this bus indicates packets received with a bad FCS, but not a stomped FCS during a cycle. This output is pulsed for one clock cycle to indicate an error condition.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_BAD_FCS_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet bad fcs reg0. Increment for packets between 64 and ctl_rx_max_packet_len bytes that have Frame Check Sequence (FCS) errors.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PACKET_BAD_FCS_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx packet bad fcs reg1. Increment for packets between 64 and ctl_rx_max_packet_len bytes that have Frame Check Sequence (FCS) errors.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_STOMPED_FCS_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx stomped fcs reg0. Stomped FCS indicator. The value on this bus indicates the packets were received with a stomped FCS. A stomped FCS is defined as the bitwise inverse of the expected good FCS. This output is pulsed for one clock cycle to indicate the stomped condition.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_STOMPED_FCS_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx stomped fcs reg1. Stomped FCS indicator. The value on this bus indicates the packets were received with a stomped FCS. A stomped FCS is defined as the bitwise inverse of the expected good FCS. This output is pulsed for one clock cycle to indicate the stomped condition.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_UNICAST_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx unicast reg0. Increment for good unicast packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_UNICAST_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx unicast reg1. Increment for good unicast packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_MULTICAST_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx multicast reg0. Increment for good multicast packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_MULTICAST_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx multicast reg1. Increment for good multicast packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_BROADCAST_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx broadcast reg0. Increment for good broadcast packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_BROADCAST_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx broadcast reg1. Increment for good broadcast packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_VLAN_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx vlan reg0. Increment for good 802.1Q tagged VLAN packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_VLAN_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx vlan reg1. Increment for good 802.1Q tagged VLAN packets.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PAUSE_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx pause reg0. Increment for 802.3x MAC Pause packet with good FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_PAUSE_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx pause reg1. Increment for 802.3x MAC Pause packet with good FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_USER_PAUSE_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx user pause reg0. Increment for priority based pause packets with good FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_USER_PAUSE_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx user pause reg1. Increment for priority based pause packets with good FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_INRANGEERR_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx inrangeerr reg0. Increment for packets with Length field error but with good FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_INRANGEERR_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx inrangeerr reg1. Increment for packets with Length field error but with good FCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_TRUNCATED_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx truncated reg0. Packet truncation indicator. 1 - Indicates that the current packet in flight is truncated due to its length exceeding ctl_rx_max_packet_len[14:0]. This output is pulsed for one clock cycle to indicate the truncated condition.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_TRUNCATED_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx truncated reg1. Packet truncation indicator. 1 - Indicates that the current packet in flight is truncated due to its length exceeding ctl_rx_max_packet_len[14:0]. This output is pulsed for one clock cycle to indicate the truncated condition.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_TEST_PATTERN_MISMATCH_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx test pattern mismatch reg0. Test pattern mismatch increment. A non-zero value in any cycle indicates how many mismatches occurred for the test pattern in the RX core. This output is only active when ctl_rx_test_pattern is set to a 1. This output can be used to generate MDIO register as defined in Clause 45. This output is pulsed for one clock cycle.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_TEST_PATTERN_MISMATCH_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx test pattern mismatch reg1. Test pattern mismatch increment. A non-zero value in any cycle indicates how many mismatches occurred for the test pattern in the RX core. This output is only active when ctl_rx_test_pattern is set to a 1. This output can be used to generate MDIO register as defined in Clause 45. This output is pulsed for one clock cycle.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_FEC_INC_CORRECT_COUNT_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat fec inc correct count reg0. This signal will be asserted roughly every 32 words, while the ctl_rx_fec_enable is asserted, if the FEC decoder detected and corrected a bit errors in the corresponding frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_FEC_INC_CORRECT_COUNT_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat fec inc correct count reg1. This signal will be asserted roughly every 32 words, while the ctl_rx_fec_enable is asserted, if the FEC decoder detected and corrected a bit errors in the corresponding frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_FEC_INC_CANT_CORRECT_COUNT_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat fec inc cant correct count reg0. This signal will be asserted roughly every 32 words, while the ctl_rx_fec_enable is asserted, if the FEC decoder detected bit.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_FEC_INC_CANT_CORRECT_COUNT_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat fec inc cant correct count reg1. This signal will be asserted roughly every 32 words, while the ctl_rx_fec_enable is asserted, if the FEC decoder detected bit.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_MM_STATUS_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx mm status. 1 - when a preemptable packet (initial fragment or complete packet) is transmitted.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_MM_STATUS_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx mm status. 1 - when a preemptable packet (initial fragment or complete packet) is transmitted.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_MM_FRAGMENT_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx mm fragment. 1 - when a continuation fragment of an preemptable packet is transmitted.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_MM_FRAGMENT_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx mm fragment. 1 - when a continuation fragment of an preemptable packet is transmitted.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_MM_HOLD_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx mm hold. Asserted when ctl_hold_request transitions from 1’b0 to 1’b1.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_TX_MM_HOLD_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat tx mm hold. Asserted when ctl_hold_request transitions from 1’b0 to 1’b1.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_MM_ASSEMBLY_ERROR_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx mm assembly error. Asserted when errors are detected during fragment assembly.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_MM_ASSEMBLY_ERROR_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx mm assembly error. Asserted when errors are detected during fragment assembly.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_MM_FRAME_SMD_ERROR_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx mm frame smd error. Asserted when the frame fragment is rejected due to an incorrect SMD value or arriving with SMD-C when no frame is in progress.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_MM_FRAME_SMD_ERROR_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx mm frame smd error. Asserted when the frame fragment is rejected due to an incorrect SMD value or arriving with SMD-C when no frame is in progress.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_MM_FRAME_ASSEMBLY_OK_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx mm frame assembly ok. Asserted when all the preemptable frame fragments have been assembled and presented.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_MM_FRAME_ASSEMBLY_OK_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx mm frame assembly ok. Asserted when all the preemptable frame fragments have been assembled and presented.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_MM_FRAGMENT_REG0
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx mm fragment. Asserted when a fragment frame is received.

spirit:field.spirit:name: STAT_RX_MM_FRAGMENT_REG1
spirit:field.spirit:description: stat rx mm fragment. Asserted when a fragment frame is received.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_GT_RESET_ALL
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl gt reset all. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Reset the GT

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_GT_RX_RESET
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl gt rx reset. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Reset the GT receiver

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_GT_TX_RESET
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl gt tx reset. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Reset the GT transmitter

spirit:field.spirit:name: RX_SERDES_RESET
spirit:field.spirit:description: rx serdes reset. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Reset the Receiver serdes

spirit:field.spirit:name: TX_SERDES_RESET
spirit:field.spirit:description: tx serdes reset. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Reset the transmitter serdes

spirit:field.spirit:name: RX_RESET
spirit:field.spirit:description: rx reset. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Reset the receiver

spirit:field.spirit:name: TX_RESET
spirit:field.spirit:description: tx_reset. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Reset the transmitter

spirit:field.spirit:name: TICK_REG_MODE_SEL
spirit:field.spirit:description: tick reg mode sel. 1 - tick_reg is used to read the statistics counters.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_LOCAL_LOOPBACK
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl local loopback. 0 - Normal operation 1 - places the transceiver into the PMA loopback state.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx enable. 0 - only IDLEs are transmitted by the core. 1 - Enables the transmission of data.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_FCS_INS_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx fcs ins enable. 0 - the core does not add FCS to packet. 1 - the core calculates and adds the FCS to the packet.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_IGNORE_FCS
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx ignore fcs. 0 - A packet with bad FCS is being transmitted, it is not binned as good. 1 - A packet with bad FCS is binned as good.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_SEND_LFI
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx send lfi. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Transmit Local Fault Indication (LFI) code word. Takes precedence over Remote Fault Indication (RFI).

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_SEND_RFI
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx send rfi. 0 - Normal operation 1 - the TX path transmits only RFI code words.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_SEND_IDLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx send idle. 0 - Normal operation 1 - The TX path only transmits Idle code words.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_IPG_VALUE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx ipg value. This signal can be optionally present. The ctl_tx_ipg_value defines the target average minimum Inter Packet Gap (IPG, in bytes) inserted between AXI4-Stream packets. Valid values are 8 to 12.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_TEST_PATTERN
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx test pattern. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Test pattern generation enable for the TX core. A value of 1 enables test mode.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_TEST_PATTERN_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx test pattern enable. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Test pattern generation enable for the TX core.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_TEST_PATTERN_SELECT
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx test pattern select. Corresponds to MDIO register 3.34 through to 3.37 as defined in Clause 45.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_DATA_PATTERN_SELECT
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx data pattern select. Corresponds to MDIO register 3.34 through to 3.37 as defined in Clause 45.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_CUSTOM_PREAMBLE_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl_tx_custom_preamble_enable. 0 - Normal operation 1 - When it is set, the use of tx_preamblein as a custom preamble instead of inserting a standard preamble.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_PRBS31_TEST_PATTERN_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx prbs31 test pattern enable. Corresponds to MDIO register 3.34 through to 3.37 as defined in Clause 45.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx enable. 0 - The RX completes the reception of the current packet (if any), it stops receiving packets by keeping the PCS from decoding incoming data. 1 - Normal operation

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_DELETE_FCS
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx delete fcs. 0 - the core does not remove the FCS of the incoming packet. 1 - the core deletes the FCS to the received packet.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_IGNORE_FCS
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx ignore fcs. 0 - A packet received with an FCS error is sent with the rx_axis_tuser pin asserted during the last transfer (rx_axis_tlast sampled 1). 1 - The core does not flag an FCS error at the AXI4-Stream interface.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_PROCESS_LFI
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx process lfi. 0 - the RX core ignores LF control codes coming in from the transceiver. 1 - the RX core expects and processes LF control codes coming in from the transceiver.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_SFD
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check sfd. 0 - Normal operation 1 - this input causes the MAC to check the Start of Frame Delimiter of the received frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CHECK_PREAMBLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx check preamble. 0 - Normal operation 1 - this input causes the MAC to check the preamble of the received frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_FORCE_RESYNC
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx force resync. 0 - Normal operation 1 - forces the reset operation.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_TEST_PATTERN
spirit:field.spirit:description: Test pattern checking enable for the RX core. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables test mode.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_TEST_PATTERN_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: Test pattern enable for the RX core. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enables test mode.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_DATA_PATTERN_SELECT
spirit:field.spirit:description: Data pattern select for RX core. Corresponds to MDIO register 3.34 through to 3.37 as defined in Clause 45.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_CUSTOM_PREAMBLE_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl_rx_custom_preamble_enable. 0 - Normal operation 1 - This signal causes the side band of a packet presented on the AXI4-Stream to be the preamble as it appears on the line.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_PRBS31_TEST_PATTERN_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx prbs31 test pattern enable. Corresponds to MDIO register 3.34 through to 3.37 as defined in Clause 45.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_MIN_PACKET_LEN
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx min packet len. Any packet shorter than this value is considered to be undersized. If a packet has a size less than this value, the rx_axis_tuser signal is asserted during the rx_axis_tlast asserted cycle.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_MAX_PACKET_LEN
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx max packet len. Any packet longer than this value is considered to be oversized.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_VL_LENGTH_MINUS1
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx vl length minus1. Normally set to 20479 (decimal). The normal value is equivalent to (16,383 x 5 -4) =81,916.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_VL_LENGTH_MINUS1
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx vl length minus1. Normally set to 20,479 (4FFF hex). The normal value is equivalent to (16,383 x 5 -4) =81,916.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_EN_PREEMPT
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl en preempt. 1 - It allows preemption.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_HOLD_REQUEST
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl hold request. 1 - preempt traffic is withheld.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_DISABLE_VERIFY
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl disable verify. 1 - It inhibits the verification process.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RESTART_VERIFY
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl restart verify. A 0-to-1 transition will trigger Verification if ctl_disable_verify = 1’b0.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_ADDFRAG_SIZE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl addfrag size. Fragment size remaining to enable pre-emption.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_VERIFY_TIME
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl verify time. Verification time-out value in milliseconds. Integer range 1-128. Default is 1 ms.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_VERIFY_LIMIT
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl verify limit. Number of times core attempts Verification. Integer range 1-15. Default is 3.

spirit:field.spirit:name: TICK_REG
spirit:field.spirit:description: tick reg.

spirit:field.spirit:name: MAJOR_REV
spirit:field.spirit:description: major revision.

spirit:field.spirit:name: MINOR_REV
spirit:field.spirit:description: minor revision.

spirit:field.spirit:name: PATCH_REV
spirit:field.spirit:description: patch revision.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_TEST_PATTERN_SEED_A_REG0

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_PTP_1STEP_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx ptp 1step enable. 1 - this bit enables 1-step operation.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_PTP_TRANSPCLK_MODE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl ptp transpclk mode 1 - This input places the timestamping logic into transparent clock mode.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_PTP_LATENCY_ADJUST
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx ptp latency adjust. This bus can be used to adjust the 1-step TX timestamp with respect to the 2-step timestamp. The units of bits [10:3] are nanoseconds and bits [2:0] are fractional nanoseconds.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_LAT_ADJ_ENB
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx lat adj enb. 1 - The delay computation on the TX path takes into account the value provided by the ctl_tx_latency_0 register.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_LAT_ADJ_ENB
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx lat adj enb 1 - The delay computation on the RX path takes into account the value provided by the ctl_rx_latency_0 register.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_TX_TIMSTAMP_ADJ_ENB
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl tx timstamp adj enb. 1 - The delay computation on the TX path takes into account the value obtained from the GT DRP read for latency of the TX gearbox FIFO.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_TIMSTAMP_ADJ_ENB
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx timstamp adj enb. 1 - The delay computation on the RX path takes into account the value obtained from the GT DRP read for latency of the RX gearbox FIFO.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_CORE_SPEED

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RSFEC_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rsfec enable. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enable RS-FEC function.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RSFEC_CONSORTIUM_25G
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rsfec consortium 25g. This signal switches between IEEE Clause 108 and 25G Ethernet Consortium modes. 0 - IEEE 802.3by mode. 1 - 25G Consortium specification mode.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_RSFEC_ENABLE_INDICATION
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx rsfec enable indication. 0 - Bypass the error indication function (see IEEE Std 802.3by section 91.5.3.3). 1 - Decoder indicates errors to the PCS sublayer

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RX_RSFEC_ENABLE_CORRECTION
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rx rsfec enable correction. 0 - Decoder performs error detection without error correction (see IEEE 802.3by Clause 91.5.3.3). 1 - Decoder also performs error correction.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RSFEC_IEEE_ERROR_INDICATION_MODE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl rsfec ieee error indication mode. 0 - If ctl_rx_rsfec_enable_correction and ctl_rx_rsfec_enable_indication are set to zero, the RS decoder is bypassed. 1 - Core conforms to the IEEE RS-FEC specification.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_FEC_RX_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl fec rx enable. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enable the clause 74 FEC decoding of the received data.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_FEC_TX_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl fec tx enable. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enable the clause 74 FEC encoding on the transmitted data.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_FEC_ENABLE_ERROR_TO_PCS
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl fec enable error to pcs. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Clause 74 FEC enable error to PCS.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AUTONEG_ENABLE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl autoneg enable. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Enable signal for auto-negotiation.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AUTONEG_BYPASS
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl autoneg bypass. 0 - Normal operation 1 - Auto-negotiation is turned off, but the PCS is connected to the output to allow operation.

spirit:field.spirit:name: _CTL_AN_NONCE_SEED
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an nonce seed. 8-bit seed to initialize the nonce field Polynomial generator.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_PSEUDO_SEL
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an pseudo sel. Selects the polynomial generator for the bit 49 random bit generator. 0 - The polynomial is x7+x3+1. 1 - The polynomial is x7+x6+1.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_RESTART_NEGOTIATION
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl restart negotiation. This input is used to trigger a restart of the auto-negotiation, regardless of what state the circuit is currently in.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_LOCAL_FAULT
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an local fault. This input signal is used to set the local_fault bit of the transmit link codeword.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_PAUSE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an pause. This is used to set the PAUSE bit, (C0), of the transmit link codeword. This signal might not be present if the core does not support pause.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_ASMDIR
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an asmdir. This is used to set the ASMDIR bit, (C1), of the transmit link codeword. This signal might not be present if the core does not support pause.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_FEC_10G_REQUEST
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an fec 10g request. This signal is used to signal the link partner that the local station is requesting clause 74 FEC on the 10Gb/s lane protocols.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_FEC_ABILITY_OVERRIDE
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an fec ability override. 1 - Then the FEC ability bit in the transmit link codeword is cleared.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_CL91_FEC_REQUEST
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an cl91 fec request. This bit is used to request clause 91 FEC.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_CL91_FEC_ABILITY
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an cl91 fec ability. This bit is used to indicate clause 91 FEC ability.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_FEC_25G_RS_REQUEST
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an fec 25g rs request. This signal is used to signal the link partner that the local station is requesting rs FEC (clause 91 or 108) on the 25Gb/s lane protocols.

spirit:field.spirit:name: CTL_AN_FEC_25G_BASER_REQUEST
spirit:field.spirit:description: ctl an fec 25g baser request. Indicates the baser FEC request.
